purpose: Protects local teacher files and makes write-back status auditable in plain language.

statusSemantics.draft_delivered: Chat-level artifact exists; no file write is claimed.
statusSemantics.saved_and_read_back: A new or explicitly approved file was written and checked at the target path.
statusSemantics.not_executed: No write occurred; the chat artifact remains available.
statusSemantics.write_conflict: The original target exists and was not overwritten.
